scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); for (const path of ['dist', 'tsconfig.tsbuildinfo']) fs.rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build: npm run clean && esbuild cli-composition/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --minify --external:agent-browser --external:tinycolor2 --external:@opentelemetry/* --banner:js="import{createRequire}from'node:module';const require=createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/cli.js && node -e "require('node:fs').chmodSync('dist/cli.js', 0o755)"
scripts.build:coverage: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); fs.writeFileSync('dist/cli.js', ['#!/usr/bin/env node', \"import './cli-composition/main.js';\", ''].join('\n')); fs.chmodSync('dist/cli.js', 0o755)"
